description: [DREAL LR] Atlas des zones inondables en Languedoc-Roussillon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Languedoc-Roussillon. The DREAL Languedoc-Roussillon has been conducting since 1999 the realisation of &x27;&x27;atlas of floodable zones (AZI) that provide knowledge of the areas likely to be able to be flooded by overflow of the rivers d&x27;&x27; water. Coverage: DREAL Languedoc-Roussillon. The portal shows the English title as "[DREAL LR] Atlas of flood zones in Languedoc-Roussillon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Languedoc-Roussillon. Its keywords include risque-inondation, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, SHP, CSV. The listing shows 2016-02-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
